headline: MUSEUMS 🏛️👆 STAY FREE 🍑 FOREVER so EVERYONE can KEEP TOUCHING 😩
text:
Listen 👂 up 👆 you CULTURE 🧫🧪🧬 THIRSTERS 🏛️🤤 the GOVERNMENT 🏛️ has decided 📜 against FINGERING 💦 overseas visitors 🧳🧳🚢 at the door 🚪😳 after months 📆 of heavy 🥵🥵 PETTING 👐 discussions with museums 🏛️ and tourism HOES 🧳💋‼️ DCMS just SLIPPED 🧈 OUT 📤 that charging 💸 would DETER 🚫 domestic FINGERS 👆 and the BENEFITS 🧺 wouldn't get 👐 FELT 😩 equally across 🌍 every THICC collection 🍑🍑 so the UK's 🇬🇧 1️⃣5️⃣ national MUSECUMS 🏛️💦 including the BRITISH 🇬🇧 one in London 🏙️ will remain 🚪 wide OPEN 🕳️ for ALL since 📅 2️⃣0️⃣0️⃣1️⃣‼️ Lisa Nandy 🗣️ moaned "our museums 🏛️🏛️ LIGHT UP the world 🌍✨ so they must 🔨 be FREE forever for everyone 👥 to ACCESS" 😩👀 while directors 🧑‍💼 like Dr Doug Gurr 🦕 admitted his Natural History 🦖🦕 spot would 💕 have LOVED 🥰 a little 🔢 extra TOUCHING fee 👆💰 but the whole 🏬 sector would 📉 have LOST ❌ its pubLIC appeal 🍆📉‼️ Nicholas Cullinan 🧔 from the British 🇬🇧 MUSECUM 🏛️ added it was founded 🏗️ in 1️⃣7️⃣5️⃣3️⃣ to be free for "all persons 👤👤" so now 🌐 EVERYONE gets 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 to keep 🔓 EXHIBITING their FINGERPRINTS 🖐️😍 on the Egyptian 🇪🇬 sculptures and more ➕

SEND 📩 this to 1️⃣0️⃣ of your CURIOUS 🔎 museum SLUTS 🏛️💋 by midnight 🌙
0️⃣ back = your favourite 🖼️ exhibits stay 🚪 off LIMITS 🚫👆😭
🔟 back = you get 🖐️ to FINGER every gallery 🖼️ for FREE forever 😌🍑
